dialogues.jp: 「分かった……家の前までだからな」
dialogues.en: "Okay...... but just until we get home, though."
dialogues.text: "Okay...... but just until we get home, though."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「わ〜い♪　お手て繋いで帰りましょ♪」
dialogues.en: "Yippee! Let's go home hand in hand!"
dialogues.text: "Yippee! Let's go home hand in hand!"

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅっ、と手を繋ぐというより、さくらの小さ
な手を包む形になる。
dialogues.en: I'm wrapping Sakura's tiny hand rather than holding it.
dialogues.text: I'm wrapping Sakura's tiny hand rather than holding it.

dialogues.jp: あ〜、本当に誘拐犯の気分かも知れない。
dialogues.en: Oh, man~. A kidnapper could have this feeling.
dialogues.text: Oh, man~. A kidnapper could have this feeling.

dialogues.jp:
日向ぼっこであったかい手は、ふにゃふにゃし
ていて柔らかい。
dialogues.en: Her hand is warm from sunbathing, and it's so soft.
dialogues.text: Her hand is warm from sunbathing, and it's so soft.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なんか良いよねこういうの……触れ合ってる
　と、お兄ちゃんのところに帰ってきたんだなっ
　て感じる」
dialogues.en:
"This is really cozy, isn't it? I feel relaxed when I'm
touching your hand."
dialogues.text:
"This is really cozy, isn't it? I feel relaxed when I'm
touching your hand."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……約束、守れよ」
dialogues.en: "Better keep your promise."
dialogues.text: "Better keep your promise."

dialogues.jp:
人の目を気にしないようにしているが、恥ずか
しさに、ついつい言葉が雑になる。
dialogues.en:
I try not to worry about the looks other people are giving
us, but I can't help speaking roughly out of embarrassment.
dialogues.text:
I try not to worry about the looks other people are giving
us, but I can't help speaking roughly out of embarrassment.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……約束は守るよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll keep my promise."
dialogues.text: "I'll keep my promise."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへへへ♪」
dialogues.en: "Teeheehee..."
dialogues.text: "Teeheehee..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなに嬉しいか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you that happy?"
dialogues.text: "Are you that happy?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへへへ」
dialogues.en: "Teeheehee..."
dialogues.text: "Teeheehee..."

dialogues.jp: にやけていて、お話にならない。
dialogues.en: She's grinning happily, and I don't even know what to say.
dialogues.text: She's grinning happily, and I don't even know what to say.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、１６０点なら漢字も読めてる点数じゃ
　ないか？」
dialogues.en:
"But if you scored 160 points, I think you're doing just
fine reading Chinese characters."
dialogues.text:
"But if you scored 160 points, I think you're doing just
fine reading Chinese characters."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ううん。英語ならアインシュタインさんと同
　じくらいはいったと思うよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, if they were written all in English, I could have
scored as high as Einstein."
dialogues.text:
"Well, if they were written all in English, I could have
scored as high as Einstein."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
そんな奇抜で聞きなれた名前の留学生が、うち
の学園にいた覚えはないが……。
dialogues.en:
I don't think there's a foreign student with such a wacky
name in this school.
dialogues.text:
I don't think there's a foreign student with such a wacky
name in this school.

dialogues.jp:
「……ちょっと待て。お前、なんのテスト受け
　たんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Wait a second. What kind of test did you take?"
dialogues.text: "Wait a second. What kind of test did you take?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ＩＱテスト」
dialogues.en: "Uhh? An IQ test."
dialogues.text: "Uhh? An IQ test."

dialogues.jp: 聞かなかったことにしよう。
dialogues.en: I'm gonna pretend I didn't hear that.
dialogues.text: I'm gonna pretend I didn't hear that.

dialogues.jp: そうしよう。
dialogues.en: Let's do that.
dialogues.text: Let's do that.

dialogues.jp:
「今から焦って勉強してもしゃあないし、なん
　か食いにいくか？」
dialogues.en:
"I think it's too late to study now, so do you wanna go
somewhere to eat?"
dialogues.text:
"I think it's too late to study now, so do you wanna go
somewhere to eat?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えっ、ホント？　｛おご／奢｝りだよ奢り？」
dialogues.en: "Really? It's your treat, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "Really? It's your treat, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺の財布の中身の半分までなら｛おご／奢｝りだ」
dialogues.en: "I can spend half of whatever I have in my wallet."
dialogues.text: "I can spend half of whatever I have in my wallet."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Yippee!"
dialogues.text: "Yippee!"

dialogues.jp:
満面の笑みで、食い気に釣られるＩＱ１６０の
少女がついてくる。
dialogues.en:
The girl with an IQ of 160 smiles and follows me, lured by
her appetite.
dialogues.text:
The girl with an IQ of 160 smiles and follows me, lured by
her appetite.

dialogues.jp:
俺はぎゅっ、とあったかい手を握り返して、長
いようで短い下校の道を｛たど／辿｝った。
dialogues.en:
I squeeze her warm hand as we walk the long yet short way
home.
dialogues.text:
I squeeze her warm hand as we walk the long yet short way
home.

dialogues.jp: ◆背に腹は変えられない◆
dialogues.en: ◆I've got to do what's best for me◆
dialogues.text: ◆I've got to do what's best for me◆

dialogues.jp: 背に腹は代えられないと承諾する。
dialogues.en: I agree to her condition. I've got to do what's best for me.
dialogues.text: I agree to her condition. I've got to do what's best for me.

dialogues.jp:
だが、なんとなく、手を繋ぐだけで幸せそうな
さくらの姿に、勉強は止めて遊んでやろうとい
う気になってしまう俺だった。
dialogues.en:
But I somehow felt the urge to spend some time having fun
with Sakura, when I saw how happy it made her to hold my
hand.
dialogues.text:
But I somehow felt the urge to spend some time having fun
with Sakura, when I saw how happy it made her to hold my
hand.
